description.en: Same as SetGameSubPhase, but always uses the "J_18" jingle for the purpose effect instead of the default "J_10" — used for more serious/dramatic story sub-phase transitions.
New game sub-phase value to set.
Whether to play the purpose-update jingle/flash effect for this transition.
Optional fade-out duration in frames (defaults to 15.0).
Optional fade-in duration in frames; a negative value skips the fade-in (defaults to 15.0).
Optional screen buffer to fade (defaults to SCREEN_AB).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Advance to a new game sub-phase with the "serious" purpose jingle
SetGameSubPhase_Serious(10020050, true, EV_FADE_SLOW, -1.0, SCREEN_AB);
